result.requirement: The system shall route low-rated feedback records to a Fulfillment Supervisor for investigation and resolution actions.
result.business_need: The business needs to proactively identify service failures to maintain customer trust and ensure fair resolution of disputes.
functional_behaviour: The system shall automatically flag a Feedback Record for supervisor review when the customer rating falls below the acceptable threshold.
The system shall notify the Fulfillment Supervisor and create a Dispute Ticket linked to the flagged Feedback Record.
The system shall allow the Fulfillment Supervisor to update the resolution status and attach a Delivery Proof to the Dispute Ticket.
The system shall prevent the Feedback Record from being archived until the Dispute Ticket is marked as resolved.
The system shall generate a summary report for the Platform Operator containing all unresolved low-rated feedback.
related_information_requirements: Customer rating score and qualitative comments
Current resolution status of the dispute
Evidence of delivery completion or failure
business_rules: A Feedback Record must be routed to a Fulfillment Supervisor if the rating is below the defined acceptable level.
A Dispute Ticket must remain open until a resolution status is recorded by the Fulfillment Supervisor.
The system must prevent the closure of a Feedback Record if the associated Dispute Ticket is still active.
Low-rated feedback must be included in the Platform Operator's quality assurance reports.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Customer submits a Feedback Record with a rating below the acceptable threshold
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the post-transaction review
acceptance_criteria.then: The system routes the record to a Fulfillment Supervisor and creates an open Dispute Ticket

acceptance_criteria.given: A Fulfillment Supervisor investigates a low-rated Feedback Record
acceptance_criteria.when: The supervisor marks the Dispute Ticket as resolved without attaching a Delivery Proof
acceptance_criteria.then: The system prevents the Feedback Record from being archived and flags the ticket for re-review
